embedding.inference: all partitions independently with frozen output weights and one vector per graph across all chunks
embedding.training_order: saved training IDs; deterministic per-graph per-epoch shuffle of canonical token multiset

svm.gamma_base: 1/(number of features * variance of standardized training matrix); 1 if variance is zero
svm.selection: maximum validation accuracy; first setting in C-major ascending grid wins ties

statistics.interval: approximate corrected paired t interval; variance factor 1/5 + 300/1400; df=4; Bonferroni 36 pairs

scope: One generated graph corpus with five paired splits, shared with the six-GNN and fixed-descriptor-SVM benchmark. Representation fitting uses training graphs; validation selects SVM hyperparameters.
